headlines.title: Poll: Latino voters swing away from Trump and Republicans
headlines.description: Latino voters helped propel Donald Trump back to the White House.

headlines.title: How the shooting death of a Houston father is igniting Latino politics in Texas
headlines.description: HOUSTON — As the sun set on a late-September evening, a voice rose over the din of traffic at the roadside memorial for Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, the 52-year-old husband and father fatally shot here by immigration authorities three months ago.

headlines.title: Can Democrats Mess With (Republican) Texas?
headlines.description: State Rep. Gina Hinojosa (D-TX) says the economy and jobs are more important than culture issues in the race for Texas Governor

headlines.title: US Marine Accused of Murdering Woman in Japan Hotel
headlines.description: A United States Marine is being held in Japan, accused of murder. Local police say 20-year-old Lance Corporal Devin Jacob Ballard brought a woman to a hotel before killing her and taking her wallet and backpack. Ballard has denied the allegations.

headlines.title: Rahm Emanuel says America is ready for a Jewish president: 'my faith is not your problem'
headlines.description: Former Chicago Mayor Rahm Emanuel tells Meet the Press he believes America is ready for a Jewish president. “If my faith is a problem for you, don't vote for me.”

headlines.title: John Kennedy says he’s considering running for president: ‘Why not me on a rainy day?’
headlines.description: Sen. John Kennedy (R-La.) tells Meet the Press he’s considering running for president, but says he hasn’t made a decision yet.

headlines.title: Accused Cornell Fraternity Member Confronted on Camera
headlines.description: Video shows a dramatic confrontation with Gillio Lopes, one of the men accused in the Cornell sexual assault case. It’s the latest fallout as more revelations surface about the local district attorney’s actions before deciding not to move ahead with criminal charges. NBC’s Valerie Castro reports for Sunday TODAY.

headlines.title: Taylor Swift pops into ‘SNL’ to joke around with host Dakota Johnson
headlines.description: Pop music icon Taylor Swift made a surprise appearance on “Saturday Night Live,” joining her friend and the episode’s host, Dakota Johnson, for some laughs.

headlines.title: The Jets might be improved. But they still can’t intercept a pass.
headlines.description: Three weeks into the NFL season, after suffering two losses by a combined 10 points, New York Jets coach Aaron Glenn held his index finger and thumb inches apart to illustrate how close he felt his team was to a breakthrough.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.

headlines.title: Sen. John Kennedy says he’s considering running for president
headlines.description: Sen. John Kennedy, R-La., said that he is considering running for president in 2028.

headlines.title: Rahm Emanuel says Democrats should focus on ethics reforms rather than impeaching Trump
headlines.description: Former White House chief of staff Rahm Emanuel said Democratic lawmakers should pursure ethics reforms rather than impeaching President Donald Trump if they win back the House.
